purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules differ from what production main deploys. 2.6.0 (main 5c5472f6) deploys the R93-08 Rules; the hunks below are R94-02 (Club Assignment spin and stop: the optional ledger key 'stops', one int 0..359 per manager inside his own confirm). Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

added: // R94-02: a draw 2 ledger also carries 'stops' (one int 0..359 per confirmed manager, in confirmedRoles order: where
// his ball came to rest). The key is fixed at create and never added or dropped later, so every ledger written
// before R94-02 keeps its exact 15-key shape and its replay.
hunks.why: R94-02 comment: says what the new optional ledger key 'stops' holds and that old ledgers keep their exact 15 keys.
R94-02: the ledger may carry 'stops' (allowed key only; presence is fixed at create and checked in the transition below).

added: // R94-02 stops: write-once per manager, only on his own confirm, the first one kept by the second confirm.
hunks.why: R94-02 stops transition: the key can never be added or dropped after create; empty before the confirms; the first confirm writes one int 0..359, the second keeps it and adds its own. Old ledgers (no key) pass the first branch unchanged.
R94-02 create: a draw 2 ledger is created with stops == [] (no stop exists before the confirms); a create without the key is unchanged.
